tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Brand ink. Text on every light ground; fill of dark grounds; the only text colour on lime, green, gold and pink.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Light ground. Text colour on ink and on dark fills.

tokens.name: lime
tokens.usage: Flow brand fill: the one primary action per screen, the logo on ink, large bands. A fill, not a text colour; text on it is ink (16.92:1).

tokens.name: pink
tokens.usage: Flow signal fill: the play triangle, eyebrow dots, the Director tile. A fill; text on it is ink (5.26:1). For pink text use pink-strong.

tokens.name: pink-strong
tokens.usage: Pink for text on white and light grounds, any size (4.57:1 on white). Flow only.

tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: Citrus brand fill and Flow data fill. Text on it is ink (9.54:1).

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Citrus highlight fill and the play triangle on ink. Text on it is ink (14.6:1).

tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: Citrus blue for shapes and illustration: the play triangle, icons, focus rings, the app tile, colour fields without text, and link text on ink (4.55:1).

tokens.name: blue-strong
tokens.usage: Citrus fill for primary buttons with white labels, and the colour of Citrus links on white (both 4.66:1).

tokens.name: violet
tokens.usage: Flow focus ring on light grounds (6.38:1 on white, 5.57:1 on lime).

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Recommended Flow light ground: a near-neutral lime-grey for large soft bands. Ink 17.75:1, text-muted 7.14:1.

tokens.name: lime-mist
tokens.usage: Recommended Flow highlight: lime at 97% lightness, same hue as lime. Labels, tool lines, chips. Ink 18.34:1.

tokens.name: cream
tokens.usage: The light yellow from the first Flow concept. Gold hue, 20 degrees warmer than lime; kept as the Citrus highlight, where it extends gold. Ink 17.8:1.

tokens.name: pink-blush
tokens.usage: Alternative Flow tint, pink at 95% lightness. Warmer; use only if Flow wants a softer, friendlier ground. Ink 16.64:1.

tokens.name: mint-soft
tokens.usage: Citrus soft ground for large bands. Ink 17.46:1.

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: Citrus alternative tint, blue at 95% lightness, for quiet panels beside blue actions. Ink 16.96:1.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page ground.

tokens.name: surface-soft
tokens.usage: Large soft bands and section grounds. text and text-muted pass on it in every theme.

tokens.name: surface-highlight
tokens.usage: Small highlighted areas: labels, notes, tool lines, chips. text passes on it in every theme (12.97:1 lowest).

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body and headings on surface, surface-soft and surface-highlight (12.97:1 or better in every theme).

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and captions on surface, surface-soft and surface-highlight (6.84:1 or better in every theme).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines and card borders. Decorative only; never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: The variant colour: big bands, the logo on ink, selected states on dark grounds. Text on it is on-brand.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brand (16.92:1 Flow, 9.54:1 Citrus).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Signal colour for eyebrow dots, small emphasis and links. Text on an accent fill uses on-accent.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on accent (4.55:1 or better in every theme).

tokens.name: accent-2
tokens.usage: Third colour for data, success and illustration. Never text on a light ground.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Fill of the one primary button per screen (D-09). Text on it uses on-action.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Text on action (4.66:1 or better in every theme).

tokens.name: play
tokens.usage: The play triangle in the logo and in-product play controls. 3.69:1 or better against its ground in every theme.

tokens.name: logo
tokens.usage: Letters and ring of the logo on surface.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring, 3px solid with 3px offset. 3.84:1 or better on every surface in every theme.
